description: AI-generated illustrative scene, not a photograph of an actual client workshop.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural, identity-preserve.
Asset type: hero photograph illustration for Max Sutter's premium leadership-team facilitation website, warm cream and rust-red visual identity.
Primary request: a believable photographic illustration of the man in the reference portrait facilitating an honest conversation with a small leadership team.
Input image: the reference portrait identifies Max. Preserve his distinctive face, light brown short hair, blue round eyeglasses, slight stubble, slender build and relaxed understated clothes. Do not copy the portrait pose or dark studio setting.
Scene: a quiet, naturally lit workshop room with warm cream walls, simple wood furniture. Max is seated at the same level as four fictional adult colleagues of varied gender, in a loose circle. He is listening attentively to one colleague who is speaking, with warm engaged eye contact. Other people listen naturally. No one looks at the camera. The feeling is thoughtful, candid, human and grounded, not a corporate stock-photo celebration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 photograph with enough room around the people for flexible cropping; Max clearly visible near the center-right in a three-quarter view; foreground participants partly seen from behind to give the conversation depth; all important faces in the middle area. Natural skin texture, believable hands and anatomy, realistic proportions, soft daylight, subdued cream, brown and blue palette, modest photographic grain.
Constraints: no writing, no logos, no brand marks, no screens, no conference stage, no posed handshake, no staged cheering, no exaggerated smiles, no business suits. Fictional illustrative scene, no claim to document an actual client workshop.
